headline: 提姆柯瑞告別 享壽80
context: 以《洛基恐怖秀》的 Frank-N-Furter 博士和《牠》的小丑聞名的英國演員提姆·柯瑞（Tim Curry）辭世，享壽 80 歲。舞台與銀幕兩棲，他把「戲劇化的壞蛋」演成了一門藝術。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Curry thrived onstage and onscreen in meaty roles that brought him widespread recognition and generations of dedicated fans.
sources.title: Tim Curry: A Life in Pictures

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The actor fully embraced his physical talents and outsized personality with a line in theatrical baddies teetering deliciously on the edge of serious and silly • Tim Curry, star of The Rocky Horror Picture Show and Stephen King’s It, dies aged 80 • Tim Curry on sexuality, surviving a stroke – and 50 years of stardom • Clowns, corsets and kings: Tim Curry – a life in pictures As Dr Frank-N-Furter, the gender-nonconforming alien mad scientist who presides over Richard O’Brien’s glam rock musical, admits two innocents to his gothic castle and induces them into all sorts of delicious naughtiness, Curry is so thrillingly liberated as to seem a menace. An irresistibly appealing menace. Apparently able to arch both eyebrows and curl his lips in every direction all at once, Curry wraps his mouth around the double-entendres and belts out the lyrics with lip-smacking relish, and fully fleshes out this avatar of sexual confidence. The film earned one of the original cult fandoms, the stage musical endures and many other actors have pulled on Frank’s corset and high heels – but the role indelibly and for ever belongs to Curry. thread_text:
英國演員提姆·柯瑞（Tim Curry）辭世，享壽 80 歲。從《洛基恐怖秀》（The Rocky Horror Picture Show）的 Frank-N-Furter 博士，到史蒂芬·金《牠》（It）的小丑，他在舞台與銀幕之間縱橫五十年，以一系列遊走在正經與荒誕邊緣的「戲劇化壞蛋」收穫幾個世代的忠實影迷。他晚年曾中風，仍持續工作。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
提姆·柯瑞（Tim Curry）告別了，享壽 80 歲。你可能在《洛基恐怖秀》認識他——那位穿著馬甲、掌管哥德城堡的 Frank-N-Furter 博士；也可能在史蒂芬·金的《牠》被他的小丑嚇過。影評形容他「可以同時挑起兩邊眉毛、讓嘴唇往每個方向捲」——他把自己的身體天賦和放大的個性，全數投入那些遊走在正經與荒誕之間的反派角色，一演就是五十年，舞台和銀幕都是他的主場。他晚年曾中風，依然持續工作。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 演員提姆·柯瑞告別了，享壽八十歲。《洛基恐怖秀》裡的 Frank-N-Furter 博士，是他；史蒂芬·金《牠》裡的小丑，也是他。他在舞台和銀幕之間縱橫五十年，最擅長的，是那種遊走在正經與荒誕邊緣的戲劇化壞蛋——演得壞，又壞得迷人。他晚年曾經中風，但一直沒有停下工作。
